subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be rebuilt to contain only the pairing allowFrom fix, or should the broad native i18n, workflow, dependency, channel, docs, and agent changes be intentionally reviewed as part of this PR?
rationale: The current head contradicts the PR body and proof by adding a large unrelated final commit with workflow, dependency, and security-sensitive surfaces; automation should not decide whether to keep that scope.

options.title: Rebuild focused pairing branch
options.body: Cherry-pick or recreate the focused pairing commits on current main, address the parse-failure gap if accepted, and leave the broad final commit out of this PR.

options.title: Split broad work into separate PRs
options.body: Keep this PR for pairing only and open separate owner-reviewed PRs for native i18n automation, dependency, channel, docs, and agent changes.

options.title: Review broad branch intentionally
options.body: Treat the current head as a broad maintainer PR and require explicit workflow, dependency, mobile, channel, and agent owner review before merge.

recommendation.title: Rebuild focused pairing branch
recommendation.body: Cherry-pick or recreate the focused pairing commits on current main, address the parse-failure gap if accepted, and leave the broad final commit out of this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the assigned PR author, project lead listed in CONTRIBUTING.md, and author of the broad final commit that determines the scope decision.
